prompts.music:
Create an original transparent torn-newspaper collage word for Dennis Agerblad's website. The reference is ONLY for the handmade pasted-paper art direction; DO NOT copy any of its existing letters, clippings, colours/letter combinations or paper silhouettes. Every single letter must be a freshly invented DIFFERENT newspaper/magazine clipping from a different printed source, including repeated letters within the word. No cloned/reused glyph-cutout, no stamped duplicate, no shared alphabet/typeface. Different print families, ink, paper, tiny natural wear and irregular carefully hand-cut/torn edges. It must look physically assembled by a human from newspapers, not computer typography. Letters close together, comparable visual heights, slight individually different tilts and imperfect baseline, small overlaps only on paper corners; all letters entirely readable. Flat front view, restrained soft contact shadow, genuine paper fibres. Horizontal single word on ACTUAL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. No photo, background, phone, other text, rays or strokes: the existing approved ray images will be retained separately. No common border or backing sheet. No black outer outline. NO Cyrillic substitutions or diacritics: use exact requested Latin letters, no Ë or Cyrillic Д/Я. Tight transparent canvas with a small clear margin around the whole word. Each clipping's paper edge must be fully present.
Exact word MUSIC, five letters M U S I C (a lower-case i is acceptable for this one I only). Each has a different source: M black slab-serif on aged ivory; U red bold rounded grotesque on off-white newsprint; S white condensed italic on a near-black printed square; I as a navy lowercase i with a small serif on pale blue-grey paper; C charcoal bold angular serif on mustard yellow. Do NOT copy the original reference's MUSIC letters.
